video.title: AI欧腐《军校宿敌/Rival Cadets》
video.desc:
死对头的风到了军校
At Federal Joint Military Academy, rival cadets Mike and Victor clash in brutal assessments. Victor harbors long‑hidden love. Surviving frame‑ups, family opposition and misunderstandings, they break free from status barriers and turn from fierce foes into devoted lovers.
在联邦联合军事学院，死对头学员 Mike 与 Victor 在残酷的考核中针锋相对。而 Victor 心中，藏着一份深埋多年的爱意。
熬过陷害、家族反对与重重误会，两人冲破身份与地位的壁垒，从势不两立的宿敌，变成了彼此托付的恋人。
